data.exact_reserve_text:
The prior accident year experience has been less benign. Deterioration on the earned and booked position on some accounts has had a negative impact on the Syndicate's result for the year. In particular, deterioration on certain Marine Insurance segments has dragged back the performance of this class. Corrective action has now been applied to this account to re-structure its composition and return it to the profitable performance it has historically produced.
The legacy Solicitor's Professional Indemnity portfolio, from which the Syndicate has now exited, also exhibited some deterioration in the first half of the calendar year based on claims development on prior years' exposures. Recent development has been more stable but reserves have nonetheless been strengthened.

prior_year_events.event_name: Legacy Solicitor's Professional Indemnity portfolio deterioration
prior_year_events.impact_description: Claims development on prior years' exposures caused deterioration; reserves were strengthened.
Deterioration on certain Marine Insurance segments dragged back performance and impacted prior accident year experience.

prior_year_events.event_name: 2013 Year of Account Reinsured to close (RITC)
prior_year_events.impact_description: The 2013 underwriting Year of Account was reinsured to close into the 2014 YOA with a total recognised profit; related reinsurance-to-close and SPS cessions affect reserve presentation.

named_events.loss_description: One of the large losses in 2015 noted by the Syndicate; impact limited by outwards reinsurance and within planned net claims expectations.
One of the large losses in 2015 noted by the Syndicate; impact limited by outwards reinsurance and within planned net claims expectations.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2015 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 418.878m. During 2015 the Syndicate recorded a material gross prior-year release of GBP 289.988m (approximately 69.3% of opening gross claims outstanding) as shown in the claims outstanding reconciliation. Management commentary also notes pockets of adverse development - notably on certain Marine insurance segments and a legacy Solicitor's Professional Indemnity portfolio - and the Syndicate records corrective actions and strengthened reserves in those areas. Current-year large losses (notably Pemex and Tianjin) occurred in 2015 but were largely managed via outwards reinsurance and retained within planned net expectations. RITC and SPS quota-share cessions are present and may affect the presentation of movements.
raw_causal_phrases: The prior accident year experience has been less benign.
Deterioration on the earned and booked position on some accounts has had a negative impact on the Syndicate's result for the year.
In particular, deterioration on certain Marine Insurance segments has dragged back the performance of this class.
Corrective action has now been applied to this account to re-structure its composition and return it to the profitable performance it has historically produced.

The legacy Solicitor's Professional Indemnity portfolio, from which the Syndicate has now exited, also exhibited some deterioration in the first half of the calendar year based on claims development on prior years' exposures.
Recent development has been more stable but reserves have nonetheless been strengthened.
Whilst there have been some large losses in certain classes in which the Syndicate operates (notably Pemex and Tianjin), the abundance of capacity in the market has prevented any rate hardening.
the emphasis the Syndicate places on managing its net risk retention through outwards reinsurance has limited the impact of these accident year events to within planned net claims expectations.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was taken from the claims outstanding reconciliation (note 11) line 'Claims incurred in prior accident years' (gross = (GBP 289,988)k) and interpreted as a gross prior-year release of GBP 289.988m. Narrative commentary elsewhere describes deterioration in some prior-year portfolios (Marine and legacy Solicitor PI) and strengthened reserves for Solicitor PI; this appears inconsistent with the large gross release in the reconciliation and may reflect offsetting movements, reinsurance recoveries, RITC and SPS cessions. RITC and SPS 'funds withheld' quota-share arrangements are present and may distort comparisons and presentation between gross and net movements. Where per-line or quantified gross PYD by LOB was not explicitly provided, amounts are null and inferred directions are indicated with lower confidence.
